# Typeform testdata

- **Create API docs:** https://www.typeform.com/developers/create/
- **Responses API docs:** https://www.typeform.com/developers/responses/
- **Endpoint references:**
  - Retrieve forms: https://www.typeform.com/developers/create/reference/retrieve-forms/
  - Retrieve form: https://www.typeform.com/developers/create/reference/retrieve-form/
  - Retrieve responses: https://www.typeform.com/developers/responses/reference/retrieve-responses/
- **Auth:** Bearer token
- **list_forms.json:** Based on response schema (docs provide schema only, no sample values).
- **get_form.json:** Based on example response in API docs.
- **get_responses.json:** Based on example response in API docs, trimmed to first response item.
